newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 66.9 bln marks in repo at 3.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 66.9 bln marks in repo at 3.00 pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank said it allocated 66.9 billion marks of securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed interest rate of 3.00 percent.
A repo pact for 68.0 billion marks also allocated at a fixed 3.00 percent expires today, Wednesday, so a net 1.1 billion marks is draining from the market.

The Bundesbank said banks bid for 176.0 billion marks of the 14-day repurchase funds this week. It accepted 38.0 percent of the bids made. The repo rate has been held steady since late August. --Frankfurt Newsroom +49 69 756525
